name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3364: HEART: his ask was that the vault and the AI item checker know every item and know what to route to garbage. The roster names uniques, sets and runewords - 1,059 names - and could name NOTHING magic or rare, because those names are COMPOSED at drop time from four affix tables plus a base type rather than drawn from a list. I told him magic and rare cannot have a roster and he corrected me on the spot: no finite NAME list, but a finite VOCABULARY, and his own install ships it. tv/affix_lexicon.py generates tv/affix_lexicon.json from the CASC: magicPrefix 269, magicSuffix 298, rarePrefix 42, rareSuffix 152, baseType 690. Over his 43 real unsure rows it reads GRAIL 14, BASE 12, MAGIC 8, RARE 4, UNKNOWN 5, and the heart row says live it can name 38 of 43. THE ASYMMETRY IS THE SAFETY MODEL: a consumable or bare base reading as PROTECTED means his stash never empties, so that direction is checked BY NAME and Sacred Rondache, Bone Knife, Horadric Cube, Super Mana Potion, Ring and Jewel all land BASE. classify never returns a best PARTIAL - an unmatched token or two parses of differing kind is UNKNOWN, and Storm Scarab stays UNKNOWN because scarab is one of exactly six rare keys with no display string in either string table. TWO TRAPS PINNED, both found by reading real data: item-names.json is NOT a base-type list (1,593 names with uniques in it - Spirit Ward and Death Cleaver are there; base TYPES are 690 from armor weapons misc), and the field is vocab not kind because the unsure row has carried a hardcoded kind item since v2051. THE TAIL-STRIP WIDENING IS REFUSED on a measurement taken with BOTH SIDES CASE-FOLDED - the first cut compared lowercase roster names against TitleCase item names and agreed no matter what was in it, reporting a reassuring 0; folded properly it is death cleaver to death, spirit ward to spirit, venom ward to venom, three uniques collapsing onto three runewords permanently. ALSO FIXED v3363s OWN DROPPED JOIN: it added reach to record_answer and the forwarding into the ledger and wired NEITHER CALLER, so every row carried reach null - byte-identical to a row written before the field existed, found because v3363s own row came back NoneType while the eye said REACH 2 of 7. Its law had pinned the INNER call, the last link of a three-link chain. Both doors now forward it and a structural case requires EVERY record_answer call to. AND THE DYLD SIP CLAIM IS CONFIRMED BY DIRECT MEASUREMENT: the house perl alarm idiom strips DYLD_ and the extractor dies with Library not loaded, rc -6, while the same call with the env built inside returns 59,837 bytes. 3 of 5 red-proofs were BLIND on the first attempt at match count 1, so the LAWS were weak: no case reached the ambiguity arm, and two cases read the GENERATED artifact so tampering the generator could not move them. All 5 PROVEN now. 483 gates.
